verdict.rationale: LM Studio is local-first: documents are used entirely offline, voice and audio data never leave the device, and users manage their local models, prompts, configurations and chat folders. That implies data stays under user control on their own machine, but nothing documents explicit retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented chat/history deletion, retention settings or auto-purge, clearing of RAG/document data, and independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
